title: Devprayag Uttarakhand - Sangam of Alaknanda & Bhagirathi
content:
Devprayag - Uttarakhand,

Devprayag is a holy town in Uttarakhand, about 70 km from Rishikesh. This is the place where the Alaknanda River meets the Bhagirathi River, and together they form the sacred Ganga River. For Hindus, this confluence is very special and is considered as holy as a pilgrimage to Varanasi or Haridwar.

The name Devprayag means “Godly Confluence.” According to legend, Lord Rama and King Bhagirath performed penance here. The town is filled with ancient temples, narrow streets, and peaceful vibes. Many devotees come here to take a dip at the Sangam (confluence) and offer prayers.

Best Time to Visit Devprayag:

  • Peak Season (October – March): Pleasant weather, 8°C – 20°C. Best for sightseeing, Sangam dips, and temple visits.
  • Moderate Season (April – June): Warm, 18°C – 32°C. Suitable for short visits and photography.
  • Low Season (July – September): Monsoon, 16°C – 25°C. Rivers are strong and the scenery is lush, but avoid bathing due to heavy flow.

Things to Do in Devprayag:

  • Take a holy dip at the Sangam of Alaknanda and Bhagirathi.
  • Visit Raghunathji Temple, dedicated to Lord Rama.
  • Walk around the Ghats and soak in the peaceful vibes.
  • Explore the narrow lanes filled with small shops and stalls.
  • Enjoy stunning views of the mountains and rivers.

How to Reach Devprayag:

  • By Road: Around 70 km from Rishikesh (2–3 hours by taxi or bus).
  • By Train: Nearest station is Rishikesh (70 km).
  • By Air: Nearest airport is Jolly Grant, Dehradun (90 km).

Best Top 10 Places to Visit Near Devprayag (within 50 km):

1- Rishikesh (70 km): Spiritual and adventure hub.

2- Neelkanth Mahadev Temple (65 km): Famous Shiva temple in the forest.

3- Kunjapuri Devi Temple (60 km): Sunrise and Himalayan views.

4- Byasi (45 km): Adventure spot for rafting.

5- Kaudiyala (40 km): Rafting and camping site.

6- Maletha Village (15 km): Known for farming and greenery.

7- Pauri (35 km): Scenic hill town with Himalayan views.

8- Dhari Devi Temple (48 km): Important Shakti Peeth on the Alaknanda.

9- Srinagar (35 km): Known for Alaknanda riverbanks and temples.

10- Kyunkaleshwar Temple, Pauri (38 km): Ancient Shiva temple.
excerpt: Devprayag is a holy town where the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi rivers meet to form the Ganga. With its sacred Sangam, ancient temples, and calm mountain setting, it is a must-visit destination for anyone traveling in Uttarakhand.
